title: Truchas 2D coupled simulation controls
description: Initial time and output schedule for a coupled flow-thermal simulation. Time-step sizes and retry controls belong to the top-level solver object.

initial-time.description: Simulation time at which the initial flow and temperature states are established. The default is zero.

final-time.description: Optional final simulation time. It must be greater than initial-time and no earlier than the last output schedule time; if omitted, it equals the last output schedule time.

output-times.description: Output schedule. At least one expanded output time must be later than initial-time.

times.description: Strictly increasing schedule times. At least one expanded time must be later than initial-time.

subintervals.description: Optional number of equally spaced output subintervals between consecutive entries in times. Supply one fewer value than times; if omitted, each interval has one subinterval.
